scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @game-is-up/shared && npm run build --workspace @game-is-up/api && npm run build --workspace @game-is-up/web
scripts.dev: npm run db:wait && npm run build --workspace @game-is-up/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @game-is-up/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @game-is-up/api" "npm run dev --workspace @game-is-up/web"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run db:wait && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @game-is-up/shared && npm run build --workspace @game-is-up/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @game-is-up/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @game-is-up/web
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run prisma:validate --workspace @game-is-up/api
